chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If you are an Imam, then recite in the last two rak'ahs Fatihat al-Kitab. And if you are by yourself, then it is sufficient for you whether you do it or do not do it.

key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ ٱلْكِتَابِ: Surat al-Fatihah, the Opening of the Book
key_terms.فَيَسَعُكَ: it is sufficient or permissible for you
key_terms.ٱلْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ: the final two of the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the last two rak'ahs of salat for an Imam and for a person praying alone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about what is to be done in the final two rak'ahs of salat. It indicates that the Imam should recite Fatihat al-Kitab, while a person praying alone has latitude, such that recitation is optional for him in this context.
